_doc: Writing styles of the typing policy besides general (prompt.json). Per style: title (shown to users), label (the App: line of the template), shots (its own examples: text typed so far -> completion: the rest of an unfinished word with no space, or a leading space after a finished word), optionally base: general (general's examples come first, then these) and instructions ({words} = the words knob; without, general's). Measured on the benchmark suite (bench/RESULTS.md): general's 6 mixed examples + 2 in the style's register beat 6 style-only examples for chat, email, academic and code; work does best with its own prompt. Synthetic text only, none of it in the benchmark cases.
